options._comment: Only for an ECC module wanted whole (in practice the hooks runtime for cost tracking). Single skills and agents are vendored instead: <Harness CLI> vendor --from <ECC checkout> skills/<name> agents/<name>.md (docs/harness/tooling.md). Apply this file with: npx ecc-universal@2.2.3 install --config ecc-install.json --dry-run, then without --dry-run. Record the choice and the date in docs/harness/review-log.md.
